title: Norwegian Lamb Kebabs with Thai Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish combining the richness of Norwegian lamb with the bold spices of Thai cuisine. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Norwegian Lamb Shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to cut the lamb into 1-inch pieces for you

ingredients.name: Thai Fish Sauce
ingredients.notes: Add a salty, umami flavor to the lamb

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.notes: Balance the savory flavors with a touch of sweetness

ingredients.name: Lime Wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve on the side for a burst of citrus flavor

ingredients.name: Roasted Peppers, sliced
ingredients.notes: Add a pop of color and sweetness to the dish

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Thai Red Curry Paste, Coconut Oil, Thai Fish Sauce, and Brown Sugar.
Add the lamb pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the oven broiler pan and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the lamb is cooking, thread the roasted peppers onto skewers.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Serve the lamb kebabs with the roasted peppers and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
